# Tina4 Node.js

> Tina4 Node.js (`tina4-nodejs` on npm) is a TypeScript web framework for Node.js 22+ with zero runtime dependencies: it runs on `node:http` and the built-in `node:sqlite`, and routing, ORM, Frond (Twig-compatible) templates, JWT auth, sessions, queues, WebSocket, GraphQL, WSDL/SOAP and Swagger are all built in. Drivers for other databases (`pg`, `mysql2`, `tedious`, `node-firebird`, ...) are optional peer dependencies. It is one of four Tina4 backends (Python, PHP, Ruby, Node.js) that share the same project layout, CLI, template syntax and `.env` variables.

Quick start. Install the Rust `tina4` CLI (`curl -fsSL https://tina4.com/install.sh | sh`, `brew install tina4stack/tap/tina4`, or `irm https://tina4.com/install.ps1 | iex` on Windows), then:

```bash
tina4 init nodejs my-app   # the path is required; runs npm install for you
cd my-app
tina4 serve                # http://localhost:7148 (TINA4_PORT overrides)
```

Routes are files: `src/routes/<url path>/<method>.ts`, with `[name]` directories for path parameters. For example `src/routes/api/hello/[name]/get.ts` serves `GET /api/hello/{name}`:

```typescript
import type { Tina4Request, Tina4Response } from "tina4-nodejs";

export default async function (req: Tina4Request, res: Tina4Response) {
  return res.json({ message: `Hello, ${req.params.name}!` });
}
```

Gotchas an agent most needs:

- Only files named after an HTTP method (`get.ts`, `post.ts`, `put.ts`, `patch.ts`, `delete.ts`) are discovered under `src/routes/`. For code-registered routes use `Router.get("/path", handler)` from `tina4-nodejs` in a module you import; `{id}` is a parameter, `{id:int}` a typed one, `{...path}` a catch-all.
- GET routes are public; POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE require a bearer token (or form token) by default. In a route file, `export const noAuth = true;` opens a write route and `export const secure = true;` protects a GET; on code routes chain `.noAuth()` or `.secure()`.
- `res.json(data, status)`, `res.status(201).json(data)` and `await res.render("page.twig", data)` are the usual returns.
- ESM only. The entry point is `app.ts`: `import { startServer } from "tina4-nodejs"; startServer();`.
- ORM models extend `BaseModel` from `tina4-nodejs/orm`, live in `src/orm/` (`src/models/` is also scanned) and declare `static tableName` and `static fields`; there are no decorators. Serialise with `toDict()` or `toJson()`.
- The database comes from `TINA4_DATABASE_URL` (`sqlite:///`, `postgres://`, `mysql://`, `mssql://`, `firebird://`). Change schema only through SQL files in `migrations/`, never in route code.
- The package's own CLI is `tina4nodejs`; the `tina4` CLI forwards `tina4 generate <model|route|crud|migration|...>` to it. Generated write routes are secure by default.

## Docs

- [Quick reference](https://tina4.com/nodejs/index.md): one-page cheat sheet of every feature
- [Getting started](https://tina4.com/nodejs/01-getting-started.md): install, scaffold, project layout, first route
- [Routing](https://tina4.com/nodejs/02-routing.md): file-based and code routes, path parameters, route groups, auth, wildcards
- [Request and response](https://tina4.com/nodejs/03-request-response.md): request fields, response helpers, status codes, validation, uploads
- [Templates](https://tina4.com/nodejs/04-templates.md): Frond template engine, filters, inheritance
- [Database](https://tina4.com/nodejs/05-database.md): configuration, parameterised queries, transactions, migrations, seeding
- [ORM](https://tina4.com/nodejs/06-orm.md): models, CRUD, relationships, eager loading, soft delete, auto-CRUD
- [Authentication](https://tina4.com/nodejs/08-authentication.md): JWT tokens, password hashing, login flow, protecting routes, CSRF
- [Middleware and security](https://tina4.com/nodejs/10-middleware-security.md): the middleware pipeline, built-in and custom middleware
- [Queues](https://tina4.com/nodejs/12-queues.md): producers, consumers, retries, dead letters, backends
- [Scaffolding](https://tina4.com/nodejs/19-scaffolding.md): `tina4 generate` generators
- [CLI](https://tina4.com/nodejs/31-cli.md): every `tina4` and `tina4nodejs` command
- [Environment variables](https://tina4.com/nodejs/33-environment-variables.md): the `.env` reference
- [Deployment](https://tina4.com/nodejs/34-deployment.md): production config, Docker, health checks, reverse proxy, scaling
- [Release notes](https://tina4.com/nodejs/36-releases.md): what changed in each release
